usd_to_eur_reference.method: Reciprocal of the ECB reference rate 1 EUR = 1.1195 USD; informational reference, not a transaction quote.

method: Before building each listing draft, query Etsy active listings using up to three product-specific search phrases. Sample digital downloads only, exclude this shop, deduplicate listings, convert current listing prices to the shop currency using the latest ECB reference rates, report the Q1–Q3 middle-market band and recommend its median. Do not apply a universal price ceiling; require at least five valid comparables and preserve every result URL and search phrase for review.

wedding-planner.note: Comparable wedding budget/planner listings range from entry-level discounted files to more complete dashboards.

debt-payoff-planner.note: The effective comparable prices observed for debt payoff trackers cluster close to five dollars.

moving-home-planner.note: Historical Etsy examples show a range from a low-price Excel/Sheets tracker to broader connected moving planners. The factory now refreshes active-listing comparables for each new draft.

small-business-cashflow.note: One premium listing is an outlier; comparable small-business spreadsheet templates mostly sit below ten dollars.

meal-planner-grocery-budget.note: Meal planners range widely; connected grocery and budget features justify positioning above the cheapest single-sheet files.

home-renovation-planner.note: Historical renovation spreadsheet examples span low-cost trackers and premium multi-sheet planners. Live Etsy search results now set the launch position within the current category middle range.

freelance-client-invoice-tracker.note: Comparable cash-flow and invoice trackers support positioning this connected freelance workbook as an entry-level business finance template.

creator-content-sponsorship-tracker.note: Comparable creator and small-business finance templates support an entry-level launch position for a connected sponsorship and cash tracker.

freshwater-aquarium-setup-planner.note: Historical aquarium-log search results indicate a broad category. Comparables are adjacent care/parameter trackers rather than exact setup-project planners. The factory refreshes active listings and exchange rates when preparing a new draft; this product differentiates around setup budgeting, equipment quotes, readiness milestones and a volume-only helper.

puppy-first-year-planner.note: Historical adjacent dog/pet spreadsheet observations; live Etsy search results are used for the actual recommendation. These are not exact first-year puppy comparisons. Differentiate around first-year preparation budgeting, provider quote questions and an offline estimate; avoid medical tracking claims.
